item.title: Mistral Medium 3.5: deprecation
item.description: 2026-10-31: Deprecated by Mistral; Large 4 recommended for new integrations. Previous direct quote retained as historical. Source: https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-medium-3-5-26-04

item.title: Mistral Medium 3.5: removed from tape
item.description: The listing was removed from the price tape. This does not establish provider retirement; check its model card and official sources.

item.title: Mistral Medium 3.5: deprecated
item.description: 2026-10-31: Official model card marks this model deprecated and recommends Large 4 for new integrations. Its current direct pricing row was removed; the previous official quote is historical. This does not establish an API shutdown or withdrawal of independently hosted weights/routes. Source: https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-medium-3-5-26-04
